_comment: Example voice configuration for the beat worker (backend/beat_worker.py). JSON has no comment syntax, so this key holds the explanation. Copy this file to beats.json at the project root (or point SILL_BEAT_CONFIG at a copy living anywhere else) and edit the prompts, transcript directories, and output globs to fit your own voices. See docs/beats.md for the full field reference and env surface.

voices.name: analyst
voices.kickoff: Run one beat now. You are running detached — there is no interactive user. Decide and act; do not attempt to elicit direction.

voices.name: reflector
voices.kickoff: Run one beat now. You are running detached — there is no interactive user. Follow your own thread and write down what you find.
